note: Art queries for Kafka's The Metamorphosis. Wikimedia Commons, PD/CC0 only. A 1915 modernist novella has no literal illustrations in the public domain, so the look is built from mood: Vilhelm Hammershoi's grey, silent interiors (d.1916) for the Samsa apartment and its doors; Edvard Munch (pre-1929 works, PD) for the anxiety and illness; Albertus Seba's 1734 beetle engravings and Odilon Redon's uncanny creatures (d.1916) for the vermin; Van Gogh's grieving figure; Degas' office of clerks; Cezanne's apples; and a bright Impressionist spring for the final, pitiless release. The fetcher adds 'filetype:bitmap' and keeps the highest-resolution PD candidate.
